name: Kashimashi Communication
original_name: かしましコミュニケーション
source:
Joutarou has average grades and isn’t bad at nor excels at athletics: basically an ordinary student. But, he’s famous in the school since he works for the ‘cross-cultural committee’. This isn’t your normal club; the members are interested in UFO and aliens, ghosts and spirits. He wishes for someone normal and one day he gets his wish in the form of a lost girl from another country. What he doesn’t know is that she’s actually a princess.

[From [url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2010/02/03/february-2010-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
丈太郎成绩一般，运动能力既不差也不出众，总而言之只是个普通学生。但他在校内颇有名气，因为他参加了"异文化交流委员会"。这可不是普通社团，成员们热衷于UFO、外星人、幽灵和灵异现象。他希望能遇见一个正常人，某天愿望终于实现——一名来自异国的迷路女孩出现在他面前。他所不知道的是，她其实是一位公主。

[摘自[url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2010/02/03/february-2010-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
